9007.t: From ἀπο- (ăpo-, “away, off”) + κεφαλή (kephalḗ, “head”) + -ίζω (-ĭ́zō, denominative verb suffix).

9030.t: From ἀπο- (apo-, “out, away from”) + πτύω (ptū́ō, “spit out”).

9017.t: From ἀπο- (ăpo-, “back”) + λόγος (lógos, “speech”) + -ία (-ĭ́ā, abstract noun–forming suffix).

9020.t: From ἀπό- (ăpó-, “from”) + λέγω (légō, “to choose; to say”).

9085.t: According to Beekes, from a Proto-Indo-European *h₂reh₁ǵ- (“to help, support”). Cognates include Proto-Germanic *rōkijaną (“to take care of”).

9065.t: From ἀπο- (apo-, “away from”) + φεύγω (pheúgō, “to flee, run off”).
